scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. A wide product shot presents an open pack of Parliament Lights cigarettes positioned in the right-center foreground on a reflective dark surface, standing upright and angled slightly toward camera. The pack is white with a blue and white diagonal graphic panel on the front face; on-screen text on the pack reads "PARLIAMENT" in bold uppercase at the top, with "Lights" in cursive script below it, and smaller text reading "Lights" and "Charcoal" further down the pack. Behind the product, the New York City skyline at night stretches across the full background, featuring the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center prominently in the center-right of the skyline; the Brooklyn Bridge spans the mid-ground from left to right, its cables outlined in lights. The sky is a deep saturated blue, and the city lights and bridge lights reflect on the water below. Lighting on the product is soft frontal studio illumination with cool-white tones, keeping the pack crisp against the dimmer background.
